title: Labour Leadership Tally Sharpens: 97 MPs Demand Starmer Quit, 159 Back Him
detail: As of 17–18 May 2026, LabourList's running tracker of public MP positions showed 159 Labour MPs continuing to support Keir Starmer, 97 demanding his resignation or an exit timetable, and 147 holding no public position. The breakdown placed the anti-Starmer bloc below the one-fifth threshold (81 nominations required to trigger a formal contest under Labour's rules) required to force a formal leadership ballot. Potential challengers named in Westminster briefings included Wes Streeting, Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham (who required a by-election route back to Parliament), Foreign Secretary David Lammy, Deputy PM Angela Rayner, and Justice Secretary Shabana Mahmood. Starmer indicated he would contest any formal challenge and continued to insist he would lead Labour into the next general election.
